assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and underlying sick sinus syndrome.
The diagnosis codes are I49.9, I47.1, and I49.5.
The symptoms are intermittent and must be correlated with rhythm disturbances.
A 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study (CPT 93226) is ordered to evaluate arrhythmia burden and sinus node dysfunction.
The CPT code for the 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study is 93226.
The service is medically necessary and directly supported by the clinical indication for the denied service (PR-204).
